title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Clinical claim 6; src/diagrams/insulin.jsx, insulin.facts entry describing other basal insulins
findings.title: Degludec duration needs a lower-bound qualifier
findings.problem: Degludec labeling describes glucose-lowering activity lasting at least 42 hours after repeated daily dosing. "About 42 hours" turns that demonstrated lower bound into an approximate endpoint.
findings.fix: Change to "degludec lasts at least 42 hours at steady state," retaining the qualification that action times vary.

assessment: One minor clinical precision issue. No blocker found in the supplied insulin worked-example logic, including midnight rollover.
